description: A tame saddled horse (speed 0.3, jump strength 0.8): walking up a 1-block step, sprint held (horses can't sprint), jumps charged for 1, 5, 9, 10 and 20 ticks, a charged jump while walking, forward and back together, left and right together, strafing, turning and walking; through cobwebs and across soul sand; sneaking off, mounted again by clicking it, quick in and out.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
